# ADR-0002 — Abandoned variant

**Status:** SUPERSEDED by [ADR-0003](ADR-0003-modification.md), 2026-08-11 — the whole decision, nothing of it survives

## Decision

The variant that was dropped. Superseded in whole, where ADR-0001 was superseded in
part; the method has one relation for both and distinguishes them by the scope written
into the status.

## Consequences

**Positive.** The set holds a record that is genuinely out of force, so an entry
pointing at it can be recognised as pointing at something that no longer holds.

**Cost, taken knowingly.** The record stays even though it does not hold.

## Implementation state

Serves the checker's test only.
